response.sql: WITH account_avgs AS (SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(t.amount) as account_avg FROM trans t INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), frequency_avgs AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(account_avg) as freq_avg FROM account_avgs GROUP BY frequency) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.frequency, aa.account_avg, CASE WHEN fa.freq_avg = 0 OR fa.freq_avg IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE aa.account_avg / fa.freq_avg END as ratio FROM account_avgs aa LEFT JOIN frequency_avgs fa ON aa.frequency = fa.frequency ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
